newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-BRIAN LAUDRUP MAY MOVE TO AJAX.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRIAN LAUDRUP MAY MOVE TO AJAX.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers' Denmark striker Brian Laudrup is considering a move to Ajax Amsterdam to join compatriot Morten Olsen, who becomes the club's coach next month.
The Danish news agency Ritzau quoted Laudrup as confirming on Thursday he had begun talks with the former Dutch champions.
"I can confirm I have been in contact with Ajax. Now it is up to Glasgow Rangers and Ajax to agree on a price," Laudrup told reporters.
But Laudrup added he would leave Scotland anyway when his contract expires in a year's time.
"It's not about money, it's about ambition. I have had three fantastic seasons in Glasgow. We have won the cmapionship three times and I've twice been voted (Scottish) player of the year.
"The only thing I'm missing is international success at club level," he added.
Ritzau said Ajax may be prepared to pay 4.5 million pounds ($7.3 million) for Laudrup.
Laudrup confirmed that two English clubs had expressed an interest in him. "Concretely I have only spoken with Ajax but I know that an English club has bid for me," he said.
Laudrup left Denmark in 1987 and has since played for Bayern Munich, Fiorentina and AC Milan before going to Scotland.
